note: two identical greenhouses: LiDAR geometry alone cannot tell tunnel-09 from tunnel-10 inside the aisles; outdoors (dock, road, yard) it can. The ambiguous cases are flagged, not guessed.

search_space_comparison_40_scans.note: grid = every free map cell 0.5 m apart (>=0.4 m from any map point, <=6 m from one) x 12 headings, so the robot can be found OFF the taught path. Evaluated with scans recorded on the path (the only scans that exist); path+grid keeps path-only accuracy while allowing off-path starts; grid alone, without the path prior, is confused by cells inside the planting beds. Off-path scans will be collected in field trials.
